scope: Scoped onnxruntime-node@1.24.3 > adm-zip 0.6.1 override and one lock record. No parent/dependency removals, attestation changes, audit exception additions or expiry extension. Removed two resolved packages and two resolved advisory IDs from accepted audit sets.

attempts.outcome: Ignored desired override; lock and installed version stayed 0.5.18. No package-count drop. No canonical manifest/lock adopted from these failed attempts.
Exact scoped override applied, one record changed.
Clean install of corrected lock succeeds, actual adm-zip 0.6.1 verified.

compatibility.methodology: Actual unchanged ONNX installPackages called against mocked in-memory NuGet metadata/archive. No network, downloaded binary, or shell execution. Valid paths, duplicate basenames, empty data and missing entry checked on both versions. Candidate-only bounded defensive fixtures; not an exhaustive archive-security audit or Windows/GPU installation proof.

auditPolicy.methodology: Actual audit-script logic executed in VM with npm JSON and clock stubs. Only shebang/import removed; no network. Does not replace the real npm audit/gate invocation.
